brief:
Gaza's municipal authority has warned of mounting dangers from vast quantities of debris accumulating across the territory following widespread destruction, Shehab Wire reported. The municipality characterized the massive rubble piles as an escalating health and environmental hazard amid the territory's devastation.

The accumulation of rubble has created what officials describe as a compounding public health crisis. Authorities emphasized particular concern over missing bodies believed to remain buried beneath the wreckage, adding urgency to efforts to address the debris crisis.
